provenance.default_run_caps: What a run that declares no budget of its own is given. Deliberately small, so that not declaring is inconvenient rather than unlimited -- the failure this whole file exists to stop is a process believing it may spend a number nobody wrote down. $5.00 is under a tenth of the $50 that BUDGET_REPORT.md G1 approved for the entire programme, so an undeclared run cannot quietly become a campaign. 600 actions is one minute at the documented 600 rpm rate limit, i.e. the most a single undeclared run could be spending while a human notices. Declaring a real budget is one argument: `SpendGate.reserve(campaign, usd_cap, action_cap)`.
provenance.usd_ceiling: Raised 2026-08-02 from $214.90 to $700.00 on the owner's instruction, given in session as 額度限制全部放开 and confirmed when asked for a figure. The old number was not an allowance, it was a measurement: $50 (BUDGET_REPORT G1, approved as P-7) + $164.90 (the other session's stop-loss ceiling, CEILING_FACTOR 1.6 x $103) = exactly the worst-case combined exposure INC-BA-003 computed and could not bound. Crossing it means that bound stops being a bound, and anything citing this programme's budget discipline must cite monitor/spec.py rows #13, #14 and #15 alongside it. $700 is not a new measurement either — it is what the four open tracks of 2026-08-02 were estimated to need (A26's long-leg experiment at ~$124, plus continuous rounds), stated to the owner before the instruction was given. It is a budget, not a bound.
provenance.action_ceiling: Raised 2026-08-02 from 24000 to 40000 alongside the dollar ceiling. The original ~24,000 was INC-BA-003's combined shared-resource figure; the new one carries no such derivation and exists so the action side does not become the binding constraint on an experiment the dollar side was widened to allow. One unit is still one outbound ARC HTTP request through the environment proxy, the quantity the 600 rpm rate limit is charged against.
provenance.raising_it: A human act. Edit this file, say why here, and append the change to PARTNER_SYNC.md. Every run records this file's sha256 in its run_start, so a run that drew on a widened pool is identifiable after the fact.

raised_2026_08_02.what_it_does_not_do: It does not retire the gate, widen any per-run cap, or bless the $136.79 of programme spend the gate has never seen. A run still declares its own budget and is still refused if the pool cannot cover it — A26 was refused under the old ceiling and that refusal was correct.
